subject.title: fix(microsoft-foundry): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in az login

question: Should the three low-level process-tree helpers become a permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/process-runtime` contract, or should Microsoft Foundry use a narrower higher-level lifecycle seam?
rationale: The runtime bug is concrete, but selecting the long-term third-party Plugin SDK shape is a compatibility decision that code review cannot safely infer from one bundled-plugin consumer.

options.title: Approve and document the helpers
options.body: Keep the three generic exports, document their platform and lifecycle guarantees, add contract coverage, and require native Windows proof before merge.

options.title: Expose one lifecycle helper
options.body: Replace the low-level triad with a higher-level SDK helper that owns detach, graceful signaling, escalation, and close settlement as one contract.

options.title: Keep the behavior plugin-local
options.body: Avoid expanding the public SDK and retain a Microsoft Foundry-local implementation, accepting duplicated process-tree policy.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the helpers
recommendation.body: Keep the three generic exports, document their platform and lifecycle guarantees, add contract coverage, and require native Windows proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Microsoft Foundry implementation provides the strongest feature-history context for deciding what lifecycle seam its onboarding path needs.
